title: Epom Ad Server Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Epom Ad Server adapter

host.description: Serving host of the publisher's Epom Ad Server deployment

placementKey.description: Placement identifier, from the placement's invocation-code tab in the Epom UI

channel.description: Epom channel: publisher traffic-slice label used for channel targeting, reporting and tracking-URL propagation. Sent as imp.ext.epom_as.channel.

customParams.description: Epom custom parameters for custom targeting and creative macros. Merged into imp.ext.data. Maximum 32 keys; keys up to 128 and values up to 512 characters.
